001package com.streamconverter.command.impl;
002
003import com.streamconverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import java.io.IOException;
005import java.io.InputStream;
006import java.io.OutputStream;
007import java.nio.file.Files;
008import java.nio.file.Path;
009import java.security.GeneralSecurityException;
010import java.security.SecureRandom;
011import javax.crypto.Cipher;
012import javax.crypto.CipherInputStream;
013import javax.crypto.CipherOutputStream;
014import javax.crypto.KeyGenerator;
015import javax.crypto.SecretKey;
016import javax.crypto.spec.GCMParameterSpec;
017
018/**
019 * A pipeline command that buffers data through a temporary file between pipeline stages.
020 *
021 * <p>This command solves the problem where validation failures in a preceding stage can cause
022 * invalid data to be written to the output stream. By buffering through a temporary file, the
023 * upstream stage completes fully before the downstream stage begins, ensuring data integrity.
024 *
025 * <p>Usage example:
026 *
027 * <pre>{@code
028 * StreamConverter.create(
029 *     validateCmd,
030 *     FileBufferCommand.create(),
031 *     transformCmd
032 * );
033 * }</pre>
034 *
035 * <p>The encrypted variant ({@link #createEncrypted()}) uses AES-256-GCM to protect sensitive data
036 * written to the temporary file.
037 */
038public class FileBufferCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
039
040  private static final int BUFFER_SIZE = 64 * 1024;
041
042  private final boolean encrypted;
043
044  private FileBufferCommand(boolean encrypted) {
045    this.encrypted = encrypted;
046  }
047
048  /**
049   * Creates a {@code FileBufferCommand} that buffers data through a plaintext temporary file.
050   *
051   * @return a new {@code FileBufferCommand} instance
052   */
053  public static FileBufferCommand create() {
054    return new FileBufferCommand(false);
055  }
056
057  /**
058   * Creates a {@code FileBufferCommand} that buffers data through an AES-256-GCM encrypted
059   * temporary file.
060   *
061   * <p>The encryption key and IV are generated per execution and never persisted, providing
062   * confidentiality for sensitive pipeline data.
063   *
064   * @return a new {@code FileBufferCommand} instance with encryption enabled
065   */
066  public static FileBufferCommand createEncrypted() {
067    return new FileBufferCommand(true);
068  }
069
070  /**
071   * Executes the buffering operation: writes the input stream to a temporary file, then reads the
072   * temporary file to the output stream.
073   *
074   * @param inputStream the input stream to read data from
075   * @param outputStream the output stream to write data to
076   * @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs, or if decryption authentication fails
077   */
078  @Override
079  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
080    Path tempFile = Files.createTempFile("streamconverter-", ".tmp");
081    Thread shutdownHook =
082        new Thread(
083            () -> TempFileLifecycle.deleteSilently(log, tempFile), "FileBufferCommand-cleanup");
084
085    try {
086      TempFileLifecycle.register(log, shutdownHook, tempFile);
087      if (encrypted) {
088        SecretKey key = EncryptionHelper.generateAesKey();
089        byte[] iv = EncryptionHelper.generateIv();
090        EncryptionHelper.writeEncrypted(inputStream, tempFile, key, iv, BUFFER_SIZE);
091        EncryptionHelper.readDecrypted(tempFile, outputStream, key, BUFFER_SIZE);
092      } else {
093        writePlain(inputStream, tempFile);
094        readPlain(tempFile, outputStream);
095      }
096    } finally {
097      try {
098        Files.deleteIfExists(tempFile);
099      } finally {
100        TempFileLifecycle.deregister(log, shutdownHook);
101      }
102    }
103  }
104
105  private void writePlain(InputStream inputStream, Path tempFile) throws IOException {
106    try (OutputStream fileOut = Files.newOutputStream(tempFile)) {
107      byte[] buffer = new byte[BUFFER_SIZE];
108      int bytesRead;
109      // Drain the source stream into the temp file until EOF.
110      while ((bytesRead = inputStream.read(buffer)) != -1) {
111        fileOut.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
112      }
113    }
114  }
115
116  private void readPlain(Path tempFile, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
117    try (InputStream fileIn = Files.newInputStream(tempFile)) {
118      byte[] buffer = new byte[BUFFER_SIZE];
119      int bytesRead;
120      // Replay the buffered file to the caller until EOF.
121      while ((bytesRead = fileIn.read(buffer)) != -1) {
122        outputStream.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
123      }
124    }
125  }
126
127  /** AES-256-GCM encryption and decryption of temp-file content. */
128  private static final class EncryptionHelper {
129
130    private static final int AES_KEY_BITS = 256;
131    private static final int GCM_IV_LENGTH = 12;
132    private static final int GCM_TAG_LENGTH = 128;
133    private static final String CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "AES/GCM/NoPadding";
134    private static final SecureRandom SECURE_RANDOM = new SecureRandom();
135
136    private EncryptionHelper() {}
137
138    static SecretKey generateAesKey() throws IOException {
139      try {
140        KeyGenerator keyGen = KeyGenerator.getInstance("AES");
141        keyGen.init(AES_KEY_BITS, SECURE_RANDOM);
142        return keyGen.generateKey();
143      } catch (GeneralSecurityException e) {
144        throw new IOException("Failed to generate AES key", e);
145      }
146    }
147
148    static byte[] generateIv() {
149      byte[] iv = new byte[GCM_IV_LENGTH];
150      SECURE_RANDOM.nextBytes(iv);
151      return iv;
152    }
153
154    static void writeEncrypted(
155        InputStream inputStream, Path tempFile, SecretKey key, byte[] iv, int bufferSize)
156        throws IOException {
157      try (OutputStream fileOut = Files.newOutputStream(tempFile)) {
158        fileOut.write(iv);
159        Cipher cipher = initCipher(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key, iv);
160        try (CipherOutputStream cipherOut = new CipherOutputStream(fileOut, cipher)) {
161          byte[] buffer = new byte[bufferSize];
162          int bytesRead;
163          // Encrypt streamed chunks into the temp file until EOF.
164          while ((bytesRead = inputStream.read(buffer)) != -1) {
165            cipherOut.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
166          }
167        }
168      }
169    }
170
171    static void readDecrypted(
172        Path tempFile, OutputStream outputStream, SecretKey key, int bufferSize)
173        throws IOException {
174      try (InputStream fileIn = Files.newInputStream(tempFile)) {
175        byte[] storedIv = new byte[GCM_IV_LENGTH];
176        int totalRead = 0;
177        while (totalRead < GCM_IV_LENGTH) {
178          int bytesRead = fileIn.read(storedIv, totalRead, GCM_IV_LENGTH - totalRead);
179          if (bytesRead == -1) {
180            throw new IOException("Unexpected end of encrypted file while reading IV");
181          }
182          totalRead += bytesRead;
183        }
184        Cipher cipher = initCipher(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, key, storedIv);
185        try (CipherInputStream cipherIn = new CipherInputStream(fileIn, cipher)) {
186          byte[] buffer = new byte[bufferSize];
187          int bytesRead;
188          // Decrypt streamed chunks from the temp file until EOF.
189          while ((bytesRead = cipherIn.read(buffer)) != -1) {
190            outputStream.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
191          }
192        }
193      }
194    }
195
196    private static Cipher initCipher(int mode, SecretKey key, byte[] iv) throws IOException {
197      try {
198        Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
199        cipher.init(mode, key, new GCMParameterSpec(GCM_TAG_LENGTH, iv));
200        return cipher;
201      } catch (GeneralSecurityException e) {
202        throw new IOException("Encryption/decryption failed", e);
203      }
204    }
205  }
206
207  /** Manages the shutdown-hook that deletes the temp file if the JVM exits unexpectedly. */
208  private static final class TempFileLifecycle {
209
210    private TempFileLifecycle() {}
211
212    static void register(org.slf4j.Logger logger, Thread shutdownHook, Path tempFile) {
213      try {
214        Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(shutdownHook);
215      } catch (IllegalStateException | SecurityException e) {
216        // JVM shutting down or security manager disallows hooks: fall back to deleteOnExit
217        logger.debug(
218            "Could not register shutdown hook; falling back to deleteOnExit for {}", tempFile, e);
219        tempFile.toFile().deleteOnExit();
220      }
221    }
222
223    static void deregister(org.slf4j.Logger logger, Thread shutdownHook) {
224      try {
225        Runtime.getRuntime().removeShutdownHook(shutdownHook);
226      } catch (IllegalStateException e) {
227        logger.debug("JVM is shutting down; could not deregister shutdown hook", e);
228      } catch (SecurityException e) {
229        logger.debug("Security manager prevented shutdown hook deregistration", e);
230      }
231    }
232
233    static void deleteSilently(org.slf4j.Logger logger, Path path) {
234      try {
235        Files.deleteIfExists(path);
236      } catch (IOException e) {
237        logger.warn("Failed to delete temporary file: {}", path, e);
238      }
239    }
240  }
241}
